- **Stop outdoor observations** when the wind interlock opens. Preserve reservation identifiers during the suspension. (`weather.md`, lines 3–7)
- **Restart only after** the interlock closes **and** the duty operator records restart approval. A favourable forecast cannot authorize a restart. (`weather.md`, lines 7, 13–15)
- **An indoor instrument may continue** during the wind suspension if it is explicitly classified as indoor and its own safety interlocks remain closed. A roof shown as closed on the calendar does not establish indoor classification. (`weather.md`, lines 9–11)
